errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of components in a chemical system, comparing the chemical to the equilibrium constant. The chart contains six slices, representing six different categories
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly refers to a single pie chart instead of two distinct pie charts labeled (a) and (b). It also incorrectly merges categories from both charts.

errors.text_span: a light orange slice labeled "7%," a dark green slice labeled "15%," a light green slice labeled "17%," a dark green slice labeled "21%," a light yellow slice labeled "31%," and a dark blue slice labeled "38%."
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps colors and percentages to categories. For example, the 7% slice is light blue (not light orange), 15% is light green (not dark green), and 38% belongs to chart (b) (not chart (a)).
The 38% slice belongs to chart (b), not chart (a), and is incorrectly included in the description of chart (a).
The description does not clarify that there are two separate pie charts (a) and (b) with distinct purposes.
The description omits the specific labels for each slice in chart (a) (e.g., 'the,' 'this,' 'for,' etc.) and chart (b).
The description does not mention that chart (b) has only four categories.
The description does not specify that the slices in chart (a) are unordered, while those in chart (b) are arranged in descending order.
The description does not mention the distinct patterns used for differentiation in both charts.
